integrity: The universal parameter and uniqueness conclusions are analytical. The standard-library checker supplies only supplementary finite arithmetic checks; the unconstrained rho=1 endpoint is credited to a previously published result.
limitations: Exactly two real stages; positive weights; stage abscissas in [0,1]; algebraic stability and classical order at least three; stiffness measure is the negative-real-axis infinite-step stability-function magnitude, not transient/nonlinear stability. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Sharp stiff-damping versus coefficient-negativity frontier for two-stage algebraically stable third-order Runge–Kutta rules
